chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin, Tiberias tuili geiah a nungzuite kiangah Zeisu a kilak hi. A kilahna thu in hih bang ahi hi.
Simon Piter leh Didimas kici Thomas akipan, Galile gam Kana khuami Nathanael leh Zebedi’ tate nih in adang nungzuite nih tawh a omkhawm uh hi.
Simon Piter in, “Kei nga beng dingin pai ning,” a cih ciangin, “Ko zong kong pai ding uh hi,” a ci uh hi. Amaute paikhia uh a, gunkuang sungah lutin tua zanin ngasa khat beek a man kei uh hi.
Khua a vak lai takin Zeisu tui geiah a ding hi. Ahih hangin Zeisu ahih lam a nungzuite in a thei kei uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in, “Ka taneute aw, ngasa na man uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Ka man het kei uh hi,” ci-in a dawng kik uh hi.

Zeisu in, “Khatvei gunkuang ziat lamah ngen na paai un. Tua hi leh ngasa na man ding uh hi,” ci-in a hilh hi. Tua bangin amau in ngen a paih uh leh, ngasa tampi khuhkha uh ahih ciangin, ngen a kai zo kei uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu’ it nungzuipa in Piter kiangah, “Topa ahi hi,” a ci hi. Topa ahih lam Simon Piter in a theih ciangin, puanak tungsilh guak tawh tuili sungah a tuaksuk hi.
A dang nungzuite in tui gei tawh kigamla lo, lam sawmnga bek kihal ahih maninah ngasa tawh kidim ngen a kai uh a, gunkuang tungah tuangin a pai uh hi.
Amaute leilak a tun’ uh ciangin mei-am leh a am tungah ngasa leh khomun kihanga om a mu uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Tu-a na mat uh ngasa kimkhat hong paipih un,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Simon Piter gunkuang tungah kahto-in ngasa za leh sawmnga leh thum tawh a dim ngen lei ah a kaito hi. Tua zahin a tam hangin ngen a kikeek kei hi.
Zeisu in, “Hong pai un la, zing an ne un,” a ci hi. Topa ahih lam a nungzuite in a theih uh ciangin, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in kuamah in a dong ngam kei uh hi.
Zeisu hong pai a, khomun leh ngasa a lak khit ciangin amaute a pia hi.
Hih kilakna in Zeisu sihna pan a thawhkik khit ciangin, a nungzuite kiangah thumvei a kilakna ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin an a nek khit uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, hih mite in kei hong it sangin nang hong itzaw na hi hiam?” ci-in Simon Piter a dong hi. Piter in, “Ahi hi, Topa aw, nang kong it na thei hi,” a cih ciangin, “Ka tuunote na vak in,” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in Piter kiangah, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, kei hong it na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin, “Ahi hi, Topa aw, nang kong it na thei hi,” a cih ciangin, “Ka tuute na cing in,” a ci hi.

Zeisu in, “Johan’ tapa Simon aw, kei na hong it hiam?” ci-in thumveina a dong hi. “Nang in kei na hong it hiam?” ci-in thumvei a dot man-inah Piter dah a, “Topa aw, nang in na khempeuh na thei a, ke’n nang kong it na thei hi,” a cih ciangin Zeisu in, “Ka tuute na vak in.

Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, nang na tangval lai-in na kawng gakin, na utna mun khempeuh ah na pai thei hi. Ahih hangin na teek ciangin na khut zan-inah midangte in nang hong hen ding uh a, na ut lohna munah hong paipih ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua a genna in, Piter in bang ci-in a sihna tawh Pasian minthangsak ding cih lim a lah nopna ahi hi. Tua thu a gen khit ciangin Piter kiangah, “Ka nung hong zui in,” ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in nitak an a nek lai takin a ang-ah kingam a, “Topa aw, nang kua in hong lehheek ding hiam?” ci-a a dong Zeisu’ it nungzuipa Piter in kihei-in a muh ciangin,
Piter in Zeisu kiangah, “Topa aw, hih mipa in bang ahih ding hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, “Kong paikik hun matengin hih mi a om nading ka ut leh, nang in bang phamawhsa na hi hiam? Nang na hih leh, ka nung hong zui in,” ci-in thu a pia hi.

Tua thu hangin sanggamte in, “Tua nungzuipa a si kei ding hi,” ci-in a gen thang uh hi. Ahih hangin, “A si kei ding hi,” ci-in Zeisu in a ci kei hi. “Kong paikik hun matengin tua pa a om nading ka ut leh, nang in bang phamawhsa na hi hiam?” a ci hi.
Hih thu khempeuh ading teci pang a, a gelhpa in tua nungzuipa ahi hi. Ama teci pan’na aman hi ci-in kote in ka thei uh hi.
Zeisu’ hihna thu adang tampi a om lai hi. Tua ahih nate khempeuh gelh khin lehang a kigelhna laibu leitungah ta zo lo ding hi ci-in ka um hi.
